name: CorPath GRX
versions: CorPath 200 (FDA 510(k) K120834, 2012-07-19; used in PRECISE, weisz2013_safety, and in the RAPID peripheral trial, mahmud2016_feasibility); CorPath GRX (K160121, 2016-10-27; PVI 2018; PMDA 2018; neuro CE/TGA 2019-2020); neuro cassette
target_anatomy: coronary; peripheral; neurovascular (angiography, aneurysm coiling, carotid stenting; thrombectomy in vitro only)
devices_driven: GRX: guide catheter (advance 100 mm + rotate), 0.014-in guidewire, rapid-exchange balloon/stent catheter; neuro cassette: microcatheter, 0.014-in wire, coils/stents (stent/stent-retriever compatibility limited); CorPath 200: all commercial 0.014-in guidewires, rapid-exchange balloons and stent delivery systems, guide catheter positioned by hand and connected to the disposable cassette (6 F in 119, 7 F in 45 PRECISE patients) (weisz2013_safety p. 1597-1598); RAPID: 0.014-in wires and RX balloons 3-7 x 20 mm, the over-the-wire self-expanding stent delivered by hand (mahmud2016_feasibility p. 2059)
n_dof_detail: 5 for GRX (gao2026_legobot Table I via S8); CorPath 200: 3, insertion and rotation of the guidewire and insertion of the stent catheter (cha2016_assembly p. 70); li2024_design Table I says 2 (conflict)
rotation_detail: clamped-wheel rotation of guidewire in single-use cassette (S8 csv)
footprint_mm: N.R. (bedside arm on table rail + radiation-shielded cockpit)
force_sensing: none (ren2023_critical Table IV); CorPath 200: proximal force measurement (rafiitari2014_current Table 3); no haptic feedback
haptics_leader: no: CorPath 200 radiation-shielded mobile cockpit with console joysticks or touch-screen buttons (weisz2013_safety p. 1597), 2 joysticks (mahmud2016_feasibility p. 2059); GRX control console with touch screen and three joysticks for device, guidewire and guide catheter (Corindus media-kit image Control-Console_HR.jpg)
imaging_compat: standard cath lab fluoroscopy; fluoroscopic, ECG and haemodynamic images slaved to duplicate monitors in the cockpit (weisz2013_safety p. 1597)
sterility: single-use sterile cassette on the bedside arm (weisz2013_safety; mahmud2016_feasibility, cassette attached to the sheath with a Tuohy-Borst); drape not mentioned in these papers
validation_detail: PRECISE 164 pts at 9 sites, 23 operators (CorPath 200, weisz2013_safety p. 1597); RAPID peripheral 20 pts/29 lesions, single centre (Graz), 3 operators (CorPath 200, mahmud2016_feasibility); GRX PCI 980 procedures pooled; neuro: 117-pt aneurysm study (10 sites), 214 diagnostic angiographies single centre, 6 aneurysm, 4 carotid stent, 10 angio/carotid; thrombectomy only in vitro/3D-printed models
key_numbers: PRECISE: device technical success 162/164 (98.8%), clinical success 160/164 (97.6%), 2 conversions for stent-delivery resistance, procedure time 24.4 +- 14.1 min, fluoroscopy 11.1 +- 6.2 min, operator dose 95.2% lower in the cockpit than at the table (weisz2013_safety). RAPID: device technical success, safety and clinical procedural success 100%, 3 minor access-site haematomas, operator dose not measured (mahmud2016_feasibility). Neuro aneurysm: 110/117 (94.0%) without unplanned conversion, 117.3+-47.3 min total, 2 ruptures 2 strokes (mendespereira2024_evaluation abstract). Diagnostic cerebral angiography 214 robotic vs 636 manual: no difference in times or patient dose, conversion 39/214 (18%) (hamimi2026_learning abstract). Meta-analysis 7 neuro studies/265 pts: pooled technical success 87% (95% CI 75-96) (tan2026_corpathmeta abstract). Visceral: 16/18 (88.9%) technical success (wagenpfeil2026_visceral abstract). Automated movements on vs off 49 pts: conversion 22% vs 18% (ruggiero2026_evaluation).
sim_model: none found (no public model of the robot; neuro in-vitro/3D-printed-phantom studies used the real robot: tomasello2024_modeling, kaneko2026_in, williams2025_robotic)
sim2real_detail: none found; only fixed-rule automation in the product (Rotate-on-Retract, technIQ), alnooryani2018_rotate (human, 1 patient, full) - not learned; Siemens ARPA-H award 2026-08-20 aims at autonomous remote thrombectomy (press, not a result)

read_level_detail: full (weisz2013_safety, mahmud2016_feasibility: CorPath 200); abstract + web (rest: S8 integration; hamimi2026, tan2026, wagenpfeil2026 abstracts via Europe PMC)
notes: MARKET EXIT: Siemens Healthineers announced May 2023 it stops selling/developing CorPath for cardiology and peripheral, keeps neurovascular R&D (massdevice/dotmed, via web search summary, not opened). Installed units still reported in 2025-2026 studies. No FDA neuro clearance found; neuro cleared under CE and TGA (mendespereira2020_first). PMDA approval for PCI mid-2018 (mpo-mag 2018-07-19). Siemens+Stryker strategic partnership (2025) for robotic neurovascular system; ARPA-H AIR award up to US$31.1M over 5 y (2026-08-20, Stryker sub-awardee) for autonomous remote thrombectomy; Siemens page: under development, not commercially available. | X2 2026-11-08: PRECISE and RAPID used the CorPath 200, not the GRX (full texts). Gallery adds the GRX control console (media kit) and three paper figures.
